newsitem.title: USA: Digital Descriptor cuts FY96 rev estimates.
newsitem.headline: Digital Descriptor cuts FY96 rev estimates.

text.p: Digital Descriptor Systems Inc on Wednesday said it see 1996 revenues to finish at about $3 million, off from earlier estimates of $5 million.
Digital said a number of the "significant" government contracts, expected to close in 1996, have been delayed and could materially increase sales in 1997."
For the year ended December 31, 1995, Digital Descriptor Systems reported sales of $2,229,691 and a net loss of $2,053,859, or $1.33 per share on 1,542,860 weighted average shares outstanding.
Company officals were unavailable for comment on the potential for an earnings shortfall in light of the scaled back revenue estimates.

Digital, a manufacturer and marketer of imaging systems for the municipal and private security enforcement markets, said its results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 1996 are expected to be released within the next two weeks.
